definitions.explanation: An abbreviation or acronym originating from English. Japanese uses many such abbreviations in everyday life, business, and technology, often pronounced letter by letter.

examples.japanese: SNSは{英略語|えいりゃくご}だ。
{日本語|にほんご}には{英略語|えいりゃくご}が{多|おお}く{使|つか}われている。
examples.english: Many English abbreviations are used in Japanese.

examples.japanese: ATMやETCなどの{英略語|えいりゃくご}は、{元|もと}の{英語|えいご}を{知|し}らなくても{日本|にほん}では{通|つう}じる。
examples.english: English abbreviations like ATM and ETC are understood in Japan even if you don't know the original English.

notes:
A compound of {英|えい} (English) and {略語|りゃくご} (abbreviation). Japanese daily life is saturated with English abbreviations: IT, PC, ATM, SNS, AI, GDP, and many more. Some are used in Japan with different meanings than in English (e.g., OL for "office lady").

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {英略語|えいりゃくご}の{意味|いみ}: meaning of an English abbreviation
- {英略語|えいりゃくご}を{使|つか}う: to use an English abbreviation
- {英略語|えいりゃくご}が{多|おお}い: there are many English abbreviations

RELATED WORDS:
- {略語|りゃくご}: abbreviation — the general term for any abbreviation
- {頭字語|とうじご}: acronym — a word formed from initial letters
- {和製英語|わせいえいご}: Japanese-coined English — pseudo-English words invented in Japan
